clauses.quote: Teachers have the right to join any teacher organization
membership in a teacher organization shall not be required as a condition of employment.
clauses.notes: Passive construction implies management obligation not to mandate union membership.

clauses.quote: employees who do not pay WTU dues shall be required to remit to the WTU through payroll deduction an amount equivalent to eighty-five percent (85%) of the amount of WTU dues effective the first pay period beginning on or after the effective date as provided in the Article titled “Duration of Agreement.”
clauses.subject_text: employees who do not pay WTU dues
clauses.notes: Assigns financial duty to workers regarding agency fees.

clauses.quote: Such deductions shall be made only as long as the WTU shall demonstrate on a semi-annual basis that at least sixty-five percent (65%) of the employees in the unit are having full membership dues remitted to the WTU as evidenced by payroll deduction or copies of checks submitted for payment of WTU dues by unit Teachers.
clauses.notes: Conditional duty restricting payroll deduction of agency fees.

clauses.quote: The WTU shall indemnify and hold DCPS harmless against any and all claims, demands and other forms of liability, which may arise from the operation of this provision.

In any case in which judgment is entered against DCPS as a result of dues deduction or other fees, the amount found to be improperly deducted from an employee’s pay, and actually transferred to the WTU by DCPS, shall be returned to DCPS or conveyed by the WTU to the employee(s) as appropriate.
clauses.subject_text: the amount found to be improperly deducted from an employee’s pay, and actually transferred to the WTU by DCPS
clauses.notes: Specifies repayment procedure for improperly deducted agency fees.

clauses.quote: It is expected that the investigation of grievances and other appropriate activities related to the administration of this Agreement shall be conducted outside of normal school hours or during unassigned teaching periods (periods when Teachers are not assigned students).
clauses.subject_text: the investigation of grievances and other appropriate activities related to the administration of this Agreement
clauses.notes: Weak 'expected' phrasing, but imposes duty to conduct activities outside instructional hours.

clauses.quote: When necessary, the Supervisor shall provide appropriate time during normal school hours for the Building Representative to investigate grievances and to engage in other appropriate activities.
Whenever Teachers are mutually scheduled by the Parties to participate, during working hours, in conferences or meetings at the central or administrative offices, they shall suffer no loss of pay.
WTU officials shall have the right to investigate grievances and engage in other appropriate activities throughout the school system at times that do not interfere with the instructional program.
The Supervisor shall afford full cooperation in such investigations and activities.
